name: Modplint Interiors
tagline: End-to-end digital portfolio, consultation booking, and CMS for an interior design enterprise[cite: 1, 7].
description: Production full-stack business platform built for a commercial interior design firm, featuring dynamic visual showcase galleries, customer consultation pipelines, and a protected administrative content management system[cite: 1, 7].
problem: Interior design studios often lose high-ticket leads due to unindexed visual portfolios, manual consultation scheduling, and a lack of self-serve administrative content control[cite: 1, 7].
solution: Delivered a responsive web application and secure RESTful API with automated Cloudinary media asset processing, multi-criteria project search/filtering, client booking management, and verified review moderation[cite: 1, 7, 8].
metrics_and_highlights: Engineered 6 modular REST route controllers covering Projects, Bookings, Testimonials, Inquiries, Services, and Auth.
Implemented automated multipart Cloudinary asset optimization pipeline handling up to 10 project images per upload (1920x1080, quality auto).
Built dual-layer input validation and rate-limiting across public intake forms (contact submissions and consultation scheduling).
Configured custom serverless and SPA rewrite proxies via Vercel for seamless client-side routing and fast delivery[cite: 7, 8].

portfolio_and_media_engine: Dynamic project gallery supporting category filtering, keyword search, and server-side cursor/page pagination
Multer and Cloudinary integration enabling multipart upload, automatic aspect ratio preservation, and cascading media deletion on document removal
client_intake_and_booking: Consultation booking pipeline capturing project scopes, timeline dates, and estimated budget ranges
Inquiry and customer contact funnel with administrative status transitions (new, read, replied, archived)[cite: 7]
Testimonial submission portal with administrative review, approval, and homepage featuring workflows[cite: 7]
admin_and_security_suite: Role-based administrative authentication using bcrypt (12 salt rounds) and secure HTTP-only cookie-persisted JWTs[cite: 7]
express-validator sanitization, CORS whitelist enforcement, in-memory rate limiting, and centralized error handling[cite: 7]
